# CLI command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command tree of the `pipefy` CLI. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command that `pipefy` registers, grouped by its top-level command. `pipefy <command> --help` prints the same text. [`README.md`](README.md) states the conventions every command shares, and [`../parity.md`](../parity.md) matches each command to its MCP tool.

## Global options

These options go before the command, as in `pipefy --token <token> pipe list`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--base-url` | TEXT |  | Override PIPEFY_BASE_URL (Pipefy API host root). |
| `--token` | TEXT |  | Bearer token for GraphQL (skips OAuth). Overrides PIPEFY_TOKEN if both are set. |
| `--allow-insecure-urls / --no-allow-insecure-urls` | flag |  | Allow http:// and private hosts (overrides env for this process). Pass --no-allow-insecure-urls to force-disable when PIPEFY_ALLOW_INSECURE_URLS=true is in env. |
| `--version` | flag | `false` | Print the pipefy-cli version and exit. |

## `pipefy agent`

AI Agents (repo-scoped).

### `pipefy agent create`

Create and configure an AI agent (`create_ai_agent` + `update_ai_agent` chain).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--repo-uuid` | TEXT | required | Pipe UUID. |
| `--name / -n` | TEXT | required | Agent display name. |
| `--instruction` | TEXT | required | Agent-level instruction (token-normalized). |
| `--behaviors` | TEXT | required | JSON array of behavior objects. |
| `--pipe` | TEXT | required | Numeric pipe id for validate-behaviors pre-flight. |
| `--data-sources` | TEXT |  | Optional JSON array of knowledge-source id strings. |
| `--active / --inactive` | flag | `true` | Create enabled (default) or inactive. --inactive sets disabled_at on create and the chained update so the second step does not revive. |
| `--strict / --no-strict` | flag | `true` | Pre-flight strictness: when --strict (default), unknown actionType values block; with --no-strict they become warnings only. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy agent delete`

Delete an AI agent (`delete_ai_agent`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `UUID` | TEXT | required | Agent UUID. |
| `--yes / -y` | flag | `false` | Skip interactive confirmation. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |

### `pipefy agent get`

Fetch one AI agent (`get_ai_agent`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `UUID` | TEXT | required | Agent UUID. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy agent list`

List AI agents for a pipe (`get_ai_agents`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--repo` | TEXT | required | Pipe UUID (repoUuid). |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy agent logs get`

Fetch one AI agent log entry (`get_ai_agent_log_details`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LOG_ID` | TEXT | required | Log UUID. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |

### `pipefy agent logs list`

List AI agent execution logs (`get_ai_agent_logs`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--repo` | TEXT | required | Pipe UUID. |
| `--first` | INTEGER | `30` | Page size. |
| `--after` | TEXT |  | Pagination cursor. |
| `--status` | TEXT |  | processing\|failed\|success |
| `--search` | TEXT |  | Free-text search. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |

### `pipefy agent toggle`

Enable or disable an AI agent (`toggle_ai_agent_status`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `UUID` | TEXT | required | Agent UUID. |
| `--active / --inactive` | flag | `true` | Enable or disable the agent. |
| `--yes / -y` | flag | `false` | Skip confirmation when disabling. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |

### `pipefy agent update`

Replace AI agent configuration (`update_ai_agent`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--uuid` | TEXT | required | Agent UUID. |
| `--name / -n` | TEXT | required | Agent display name. |
| `--repo-uuid` | TEXT | required | Pipe UUID. |
| `--instruction` | TEXT | required | Agent-level instruction. |
| `--behaviors` | TEXT | required | JSON array of behavior objects. |
| `--pipe` | TEXT | required | Numeric pipe id for validate-behaviors pre-flight. |
| `--data-sources` | TEXT |  | Optional JSON array of knowledge-source id strings. Omit to keep the agent's current knowledge bases; pass '[]' to detach them all. |
| `--disabled-at` | TEXT |  | Optional ISO-8601 disabledAt from agent get. Pass through to skip the preserve re-read; omit to let the SDK preserve. |
| `--strict / --no-strict` | flag | `true` | Pre-flight strictness: --strict (default) blocks on unknown actionType values; --no-strict converts them to warnings. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |

### `pipefy agent validate-behaviors`

Dry-run behavior validation (`validate_ai_agent_behaviors`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--pipe` | TEXT | required | Numeric pipe id. |
| `--behaviors` | TEXT | required | JSON array of behavior objects. |
| `--strict / --no-strict` | flag | `true` | Pre-flight strictness: --strict (default) reports unknown actionType values as problems; --no-strict reports them as warnings only. |
| `--data-source-id` | TEXT |  | Agent-level knowledge base ID to attach (repeatable). Unioned with behavior-level dataSourceIds and checked against the pipe's knowledge bases; unknown IDs are warnings only. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |

## `pipefy ai-provider`

LLM providers (organization-scoped: discovery reads and provider writes).

### `pipefy ai-provider create`

Create a custom (BYOM) LLM provider (`create_llm_provider`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--org-uuid` | TEXT | required | Organization UUID (not the numeric ID; `pipefy org get` shows both). |
| `--name` | TEXT | required | Display name (required). |
| `--config-file / -f` | PATH | required | Local JSON file with the provider configuration object (secrets stay in the file; never passed inline). Supports ~ expansion. Its `provider` key uses hyphenated vendor strings (amazon-bedrock, oracle-oci) — not the snake_case form `ai-provider models --provider-name` takes; the two are not interchangeable. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy ai-provider default get`

Resolve the default LLM provider for an owner (`get_default_llm_provider`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--owner-id` | TEXT | required | Owner identifier. For --owner-type organization pass the numeric organization ID (not the UUID). |
| `--owner-type` | TEXT | `organization` | One of: organization (default), assistant, behavior. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy ai-provider default reset`

Reset (clear) the organization's default LLM provider (`reset_default_llm_provider`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--org-id` | TEXT | required | Numeric organization ID (not the UUID; `pipefy org get` shows both). |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy ai-provider default set`

Set the organization's default LLM provider (`set_default_llm_provider`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--org-id` | TEXT | required | Numeric organization ID (not the UUID; `pipefy org get` shows both). |
| `--provider-id` | TEXT |  | Custom (BYOM) provider ID to make the default. |
| `--system-provider-id` | TEXT |  | System provider ID to make the default. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy ai-provider delete`

Delete a custom (BYOM) LLM provider permanently (`delete_llm_provider`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--id` | TEXT | required | Provider ID to delete. |
| `--org-uuid` | TEXT | required | Organization UUID (not the numeric ID; `pipefy org get` shows both). |
| `--yes / -y` | flag | `false` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy ai-provider dependencies`

List owners that depend on a provider (`get_llm_provider_dependencies`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider-id` | TEXT | required | Provider ID (from `pipefy ai-provider list`). |
| `--org-uuid` | TEXT | required | Organization UUID (not the numeric ID; `pipefy org get` shows both). |
| `--first` | INTEGER | `50` | Page size. |
| `--after` | TEXT |  | Cursor from the previous page's page_info.endCursor. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy ai-provider list`

List custom (BYOM) and Pipefy-managed system LLM providers (`get_llm_providers`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--org-uuid` | TEXT | required | Organization UUID (not the numeric ID; `pipefy org get` shows both). |
| `--only-active` | flag | `false` | Only return active custom providers (system providers unaffected). |
| `--first` | INTEGER | `50` | Page size. |
| `--after` | TEXT |  | Cursor from the previous page's page_info.endCursor. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy ai-provider models`

List the model names a provider vendor exposes (`get_available_ai_models`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider-name` | TEXT | required | Provider vendor: openai, azure_openai, amazon_bedrock, custom, google_vertex_ai, oracle_oci, or anthropic. Snake_case here; the `provider` key in the create/update --config-file uses the hyphenated form (amazon-bedrock) — not interchangeable. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

| `--active / --inactive` | flag | required | Activate (--active) or deactivate (--inactive) the provider. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy ai-provider update`

Update a custom (BYOM) LLM provider (`update_llm_provider`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--id` | TEXT | required | Provider ID to update (from `pipefy ai-provider list`). |
| `--org-uuid` | TEXT | required | Organization UUID (not the numeric ID; `pipefy org get` shows both). |

Its `provider` key uses hyphenated vendor strings (amazon-bedrock, oracle-oci) — not the snake_case form `ai-provider models --provider-name` takes; the two are not interchangeable. |
| `--name` | TEXT |  | New name (non-blank). |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

## `pipefy attachment`

Attachment uploads (presigned URL + field update).

### `pipefy attachment presign`

Mint a presigned S3 upload target without transferring any bytes.

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--file-name` | TEXT | required | File name including extension; names the stored object. |
| `--organization / --org` | TEXT | required | Organization id (numeric or uuid). |
| `--content-type` | TEXT |  | Optional MIME type to sign into the upload. |
| `--content-length` | INTEGER |  | Optional exact byte length to sign into the upload. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy attachment upload`

Upload a local file to a card or table record attachment field.

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--file / -f` | PATH | required | Local file path to upload. Supports ~ expansion. |
| `--card` | TEXT |  | Target card id (mutually exclusive with --record). |
| `--record` | TEXT |  | Target table record id (mutually exclusive with --card). |
| `--organization / --org` | TEXT | required | Organization id (required for presigned URL). |
| `--field` | TEXT | required | Attachment field slug on the card or table record. |
| `--content-type` | TEXT |  | Optional MIME type (defaults from file name). |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

| `--pipe` | TEXT | required | Pipe UUID for the audit export. |
| `--search` | TEXT |  | Optional search term filter passed to the API. |

## `pipefy auth`

Authenticate the CLI as your Pipefy user (browser-based login).

### `pipefy auth login`

Sign in to Pipefy via your browser and store the session in the OS keychain.

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--no-browser` | flag | `false` | Print the authorization URL instead of opening a browser. |
| `--callback-timeout` | FLOAT RANGE | `180.0` | Seconds to wait for the browser callback before giving up. |

### `pipefy auth logout`

Clear the local session, revoking the refresh token when it can be read.

Takes no arguments or options.

### `pipefy auth status`

Print which auth source is active, the authenticated identity, and session expiry.

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Emit a stable JSON schema instead of human-readable text. |

## `pipefy automation`

Traditional automations and related exports.

### `pipefy automation actions list`

List action types for a pipe (`get_automation_actions`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--pipe` | TEXT | required | Pipe id. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy automation create`

Create an automation rule (`create_automation`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--pipe` | TEXT | required | Source pipe id (trigger context). |
| `--name / -n` | TEXT | required | Rule name. |
| `--event-id / --trigger-id` | TEXT | required | Trigger event id from `automation events list` (`--trigger-id` retained as alias). |
| `--action-id` | TEXT | required | Action id from `automation actions list`. |
| `--active / --no-active` | flag | `true` | Create enabled or disabled. |
| `--action-repo` | TEXT |  | Destination pipe id for cross-pipe actions (defaults to --pipe). |
| `--condition` | TEXT |  | Optional JSON ConditionInput: {"expressions": [{"field_address": "&lt;internal_id>", "operation": "equals", "value": "x", "structure_id": 0}], "expressions_structure": [[0]]}. field_address is a field internal_id (not a slug); operations include equals, not_equals, present, blank, string_contains, number_greater_than, date_is_after. expressions_structure lists structure_id values: AND inside an inner array, OR across inner arrays, so [[0, 1], [2]] is (0 AND 1) OR 2. |
| `--extra` | TEXT |  | Optional JSON object: extra CreateAutomationInput fields. Top-level keys are snake_case (e.g. action_params, event_params); camelCase is also accepted. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

### `pipefy automation delete`

Delete an automation rule (`delete_automation`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTOMATION_ID` | TEXT | required | Automation rule id. |
| `--yes / -y` | flag | `false` | Skip interactive confirmation. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

| `--extra` | TEXT |  | JSON object: UpdateAutomationInput fields to patch. Top-level keys are snake_case (e.g. action_params, event_params); camelCase is also accepted. |

### `pipefy automation usage`

Automation usage for an org in a date range (`get_automations_usage`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `CARD_ID` | TEXT | required | Card id. |
| `--title / -t` | TEXT |  |  |
| `--due-date` | TEXT |  |  |
| `--assignee-ids` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated assignee user ids (replaces the card's whole assignee list). |
| `--label-ids` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated label ids (replaces the card's whole label list). |
| `--field-updates` | TEXT |  | JSON array of field update objects for updateFieldsValues. Each object: {"field_id" (or "fieldId"): "&lt;slug>", "value": &lt;v>, "operation": "ADD"\|"REMOVE"\|"REPLACE" (optional, default REPLACE)}. For list-valued fields (connections, attachments, checklists), prefer ADD/REMOVE; for connectors, send related card ids. If set, attribute flags (--title, --assignee-ids, --label-ids, --due-date) are discarded. Pipe labels and assignees are not fields: use --label-ids / --assignee-ids. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |

## `pipefy portal`

Delete a portal permanently.

### `pipefy portal element create`

| `--page-id` | TEXT | required | Parent page UUID. |
| `--type` | TEXT | required | InterfacePageElementType value (e.g. forms, link). |

| `PAGE_ID` | TEXT | required | Parent page UUID. |
| `--layout` | TEXT |  | Full page layout row array (get_portal pages[].layout) with the element removed from every row, to prune the grid in the same call. Each row needs a non-empty id, type row, and string children. |

| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

| `--format` | TEXT | `json` | json: print mutation + poll metadata; csv: wait for fileURL and stream bytes. |
| `--sort-by` | TEXT |  | JSON ReportSortDirectionInput. |
| `--filter` | TEXT |  |  |
| `--columns` | TEXT |  | JSON array of column names from report-pipe columns; date columns appear only when named here. |
| `--poll-timeout` | FLOAT | `90.0` | Seconds to poll export status before failing (CSV only). |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` | Print machine-readable JSON to stdout. |

## `pipefy service-account`

Organization service account operations.

### `pipefy service-account create`

Create an org service account. Prints the client secret once — store it now.

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--org` | TEXT | required | Organization UUID. |
| `--name` | TEXT | required | Service account name (&lt;=20 chars). |
| `--role` | TEXT | `normal` | Org role (admin, normal, company_guest, external_guest). |
| `--description` | TEXT |  | Optional description. |
| `--expiration-unit` | TEXT |  | Token lifetime unit (seconds/minutes/hours/days). |
| `--expiration-value` | INTEGER |  | Token lifetime value (positive int). |
| `--pipe-ids` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated pipe IDs to add the new account to immediately. |
| `--pipe-role` | TEXT | `admin` | Pipe role for --pipe-ids (default admin). |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |

### `pipefy service-account delete`

Permanently delete an org service account (revokes its credentials).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--org` | TEXT | required | Organization UUID. |
| `--id` | TEXT | required | Service account UUID. |
| `--yes / -y` | flag | `false` | Skip confirmation prompt. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |

Automation usage for an org (`get_automations_usage`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |

| `--organization / --org` | TEXT | required |  |
| `--from` | TEXT | required |  |
| `--to` | TEXT | required |  |
| `--filters` | TEXT |  |  |
| `--search` | TEXT |  |  |
| `--sort` | TEXT |  |  |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |

AI credit usage dashboard (`get_ai_credit_usage`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |

| `--organization / --org` | TEXT | required |  |
| `--period` | TEXT | `current_month` | current_month \| last_month \| last_3_months |

### `pipefy usage execution-metrics`

Automation execution metrics (`get_automation_execution_metrics`).

| Argument or option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--organization / --org` | TEXT | required | Organization ID (numeric org id, same as in the Pipefy URL). |
| `--automation / -a` | TEXT |  | Automation ID to fetch metrics for (repeat for multiple; omit to fetch all automations in the organization). |
| `--repo` | TEXT |  | Optional pipe/repo ID to scope the query. |
| `--action` | TEXT |  | Action ID to filter by (repeat for multiple). |
| `--event` | TEXT |  | Filter by trigger event: card_moved \| field_updated \| card_created \| scheduler \| sla_based \| card_left_phase \| card_inbox_received_email \| all_children_in_phase \| http_response_received \| manually_triggered. |
| `--active / --inactive` | flag |  | Filter enabled (--active) or disabled (--inactive) automations. |
| `--search` | TEXT |  | Free-text match on automation name. |
| `--sort-by` | TEXT |  | Sort field: created_at \| name. |
| `--sort-order` | TEXT |  | Sort direction: asc \| desc. |
| `--period` | TEXT | `SIXTY_MINUTES` | FIFTEEN_MINUTES \| SIXTY_MINUTES \| TWELVE_HOURS \| TWENTY_FOUR_HOURS |
| `--first` | INTEGER | `50` | Page size (1-50). |
| `--after` | TEXT |  | Cursor from a previous page's page_info.endCursor. |
| `--json / -j` | flag | `false` |  |
